channel.title: Daily Prayer
channel.description: A daily prayer for each day of the month

item.title: Prayer for 1 January
item.description: Today we praying for everyone who is looking forward to - or worried about - what 2026 may bring. God, walk with us all.

item.title: Prayer for 2 January
item.description: Today we praying for the discussions between Ukraine, Russia, and other world governments that a lasting peace may be secured.

item.title: Prayer for 3 January
item.description: Today we praying for compassion and understanding of others in our multi-cultural society.

item.title: Prayer for 4 January
item.description: Today we praying for Heather and Phil as Heather retires and they embrace the next step in their lives together. We thank them for all they have done for St. James.

item.title: Prayer for 5 January
item.description: Today we praying for our local schools as they return for the new term.

item.title: Prayer for 6 January
item.description: Today we praying for our local care homes. Father God, please bless residents, visitors and all those involved in delivering care.

item.title: Prayer for 7 January
item.description: Today we praying that the fragile peace between Gaza and Israel becomes sustainable and just for everyone.

item.title: Prayer for 8 January
item.description: Today we praying for the congregation as they worship today at the Thursday service. Bless the connections made and the friendships that flourish.

item.title: Prayer for 9 January
item.description: Today we praying for Ian after his accident, for Jan, and for everyone who is looking after him.

item.title: Prayer for 10 January
item.description: Today we praying for the safety of Taiwan and its people in uncertain and dangerous times.

item.title: Prayer for 11 January
item.description: Today we praying for our service. Father God, draw alongside us as we come together to worship You.

item.title: Prayer for 12 January
item.description: Today we praying for our local Citizens Advice Bureau and all of the help they offer to those struggling in our community.

item.title: Prayer for 13 January
item.description: Today we praying for those struggling with utility bills and the cost of living.

item.title: Prayer for 14 January
item.description: Today we praying for each of us to find a way of reducing our carbon footprint.

item.title: Prayer for 15 January
item.description: Today we praying for the people who volunteer and donate food to One Can and the people who receive this support.

item.title: Prayer for 16 January
item.description: Today we praying for anyone who has lost a loved one due to war. Please Lord, comfort and strengthen them.

item.title: Prayer for 17 January
item.description: Today we praying for an end to extremism and hatred fuelled by racial, faith, gender, or social differences.

item.title: Prayer for 18 January
item.description: Today we praying for our service this morning and for the friendships that flourish at St. James.

item.title: Prayer for 19 January
item.description: Today we praying for the World Economic Forum in Davos. Father God, please gift Your wisdom and compassion to economic leaders to deliver a more just society.

item.title: Prayer for 20 January
item.description: Today we praying for Wycombe Homeless Connection and the night shelter.

item.title: Prayer for 21 January
item.description: Today we praying for the protection of our national critical infrastructure against global cybercrime.

item.title: Prayer for 22 January
item.description: Today we praying for an increase in international co-operation to deliver humanitarian aid.

item.title: Prayer for 23 January
item.description: Today we praying for our local businesses in Downley as they serve our community.

item.title: Prayer for 24 January
item.description: Today we praying for all health and social workers across High Wycombe.

item.title: Prayer for 25 January
item.description: Today we praying for churches across High Wycombe and give thanks for the way our local churches work together.

item.title: Prayer for 26 January
item.description: Today we praying for and end to knife crime, especially in schools and amongst young people.

item.title: Prayer for 27 January
item.description: Today we praying for food security for people living in poverty and hunger in Brazil.

item.title: Prayer for 28 January
item.description: Today we praying for the safety of our young people online and on social media.

item.title: Prayer for 29 January
item.description: Today we praying for all farmers and those working to help produce our food.

item.title: Prayer for 30 January
item.description: Today we praying for an end to corruption in governments across the world.

item.title: Prayer for 31 January
item.description: Today we praying for people in the emergency services namely the fire brigade, ambulance workers and police. Support them as they help others.
